services.desc: Have you ever had an idea pop into your head and you just know that somehow - some way you have to make that idea a reality? All I have ever been is a guide. It’s all I have ever wanted to be. It’s never been the adrenaline of a Class V rapid, the height of the mountains, or the speed of a jet ski that has kept me passionate about guiding. It’s that moment you get to share with people when the day they have been dreaming about comes true and you get to help make that happen! It’s one of the best professions in the world.
